basic_info.main_problem: 在与陌生人进行简短互动后常感到自己'not有趣,很without聊',并将对方not回应视为对自我价值的negate;问题在多次类似经历后加重,导致Social anxiety上升,影响在公共场合与Social gatherings中的体验与参与.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of inferiority affect my ability to connect with others and enjoy social situations.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on whether others are willing to talk with me

special_situations.event: 在地铁上身旁的人not愿与我交谈或have not回应
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not愿意与我交谈或have not回应,就说明我是without趣,not可被关注的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 当场撤退,避免继续交流以降低Being rejected的not适
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他not想和我说话,一定是我很without聊

special_situations.event: 在聚会上以读书话题开启对话,对方显得not感兴趣并很快转向他人
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能立即吸引对方注意,就证明I have no value,很without聊
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 迅速停止社交尝试,Being alone或退出情境以避免进一步尴尬
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我太without聊了,have not人愿意和我说话

special_situations.event: 在公共场合经历多次简短互动后,对方not yet继续交谈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 多次Being rejected或not被接续=我一向都without聊,将来也会如此
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少参加公共活动与Social situations,以回避可能的negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我总是这样not人愿意理我

special_situations.event: 在Work场合准备与同事交流时担心被视为without聊
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果同事觉得我without聊,我会被排斥,not被接纳

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们大概也觉得我without趣,我最好not要多说

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen and accepted, to build genuine and relaxed connections with others
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected,被评判为'without聊',感到羞耻与Self-denial
defense_goal: 通过回避或撤退来降低Being rejected的风险
Uses excessive analysis and self-deprecation to lower expectations in advance and avoid greater disappointment

object_relations.object_representation: 冷淡,挑剔或对自己not感兴趣的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师Silence片刻或not yet立即给予肯定反馈时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Luo Shan会倾向于认为对方和他人一样在评判自己'without聊'(将内在Self-denial投向他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和与稳定,先Empathy其担忧;邀请具体化证据与替代Interpretation,Clarification彼此感受,并通过当下验证减少假设.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to stop analyzing and turn to describing the current emotional experience
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向于继续细致分析互动细节,以避免直面羞耻与Being rejected的感受
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 放慢语速与节奏,use情感反映与身体感受觉察的Guidance,减少问题求证式Questioning,鼓励Naming emotions并保持短暂停顿.
